object: Lived circulation, shade, tools, pets, water, and acceptance

features.label: Left roof collection surface

features.non_claim: Does not establish roof condition, drainage performance, gutter connection, runoff volume, or ownership.

features.label: Front gable left plane
features.evidence: The left plane of the front gable roof is visibly distinguishable.
features.non_claim: Does not establish condition, connection, runoff volume, or drainage performance.

features.label: Front gable right plane
features.evidence: The right plane of the front gable roof is visibly distinguishable.
features.non_claim: Does not establish condition, connection, runoff volume, or drainage performance.

features.label: Porch roof collection surface
features.evidence: A lower porch roof plane is visibly exposed to precipitation.
features.non_claim: Does not establish gutter connection, roof condition, runoff volume, or discharge path.

features.label: Left eave eave edge
features.evidence: A visible roof-edge line is visible along the lower edge of the left roof plane.
features.non_claim: The image does not establish whether a gutter is present, continuous, connected, sized, or functional.

features.label: Porch eave eave edge
features.evidence: A visible roof-edge line is visible along the porch roof edge.
features.non_claim: The image does not establish whether a gutter is present, continuous, connected, sized, or functional.

unknowns: Ownership, utility, excavation, and work authority

seat.label: Crew / Steward
seat.evidence: Source receipts, image-specific registration, field holds, access, utilities, equipment, safety, scope, and affected-actor acceptance.
seat.next_safe_action: Use the visible collection and conveyance inventory to prepare a drainage verification question. Confirm rainfall, flow, connection, discharge, condition, utilities, access, and affected-actor authority before acting.
seat.acceptance: Scope, access, safety, execution, before-and-after evidence, refusal, and completion or hold are independently reviewable.
seat.authority: Read-only visual interpretation. No drainage finding, watering instruction, excavation, utility, entry, work, or completion authority.
seat.handoff: Return verified questions, an accepted proposal, a refusal, or a completion receipt to the resident and program operator.

claim_boundary: The receipt identifies only visible roof collection surfaces and roof-edge lines in the exact named image. It does not establish a gutter, downspout, observed flow, drainage performance, connection, discharge destination, ownership, or current condition.
